cross_verification.note_en: SMF (Servico de Migracao e Fronteiras) is Sao Tome and Principe's official migration/passport authority (smf.st), confirmed reachable and legitimate by direct access; the homepage confirms an electronic passport was launched by the Government, and its FAQ page (fq.php) covers visa exemption/cost topics only. No page reachable during this research published passport photo dimensions, background color, or facial-pose specifications. Search-engine indexing attributes a 'passport-type photo, white background, PNG/JPEG format' requirement for non-presential (remote) passport applications to SMF, originating from a news article (stp-press.st) that returned 'Account Suspended' when fetched directly. Because this specific claim could not be confirmed by directly reading a live official page, it is withheld from verified per the truthfulness policy rather than reported as confirmed.
